name: grid402-mcp
description: Grid402 MCP Server - Verifiable Data and HTTP x402 Payment Layer for Autonomous AI Agents across Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana, Optimism and Ethereum (27 tools: Web-to-Markdown Extractor, Zero-PII Email Verifier, KYB 360 AI Dossier, Financial Markets, Global LEI, OFAC AML, Compliance 360, Network Audits and Session Pass).
instructions: Use free tools first (grid402_summary, grid402_pass_balance, grid402_verify). Prefer composite bundles (grid402_get_dossier_360, grid402_domain_audit, grid402_kyb_audit, grid402_market_snapshot) and global utilities (grid402_extract, grid402_email_verify) to save credits and latency. Set GRID402_SANDBOX=true for free sandbox testing (3 req/day/IP), GRID402_SESSION_PASS for sub-15ms prepaid calls (1 credit = 0.0050 USDC), or gasless PayAI x402 settlement on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana.
